title: Coordinated Multi-Account Credential Stuffing Campaign
summary: Distributed credential stuffing pattern identified across 8 distinct username fingerprints using automated pacing.
detection_explanation: Correlation engine detected low-and-slow authentication failures targeting distinct corporate username fingerprints from identical source subnet.

evidence.summary: Correlation of 42 authentication failures across 8 unique HMAC username hashes spanning 2 persistent sessions

mitre_attack.mapping_evidence: Sequential automated login attempts testing known credentials across multiple employee usernames.

recommendations.recommended_action: Execute immediate defensive isolation: block CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 at perimeter and verify production identity logs for compromised accounts matching observed fingerprints.
recommendations.recommendation_reason: Sustained credential stuffing pattern indicates adversary utilizing compromised credential dumps.
